name: Ro48-8684
summary: Ro48-8684 is a water-soluble benzodiazepine derivative developed by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1990s, which was designed along with Ro48-6791 as an improved replacement for midazolam, but ultimately proved to have little advantages over the parent drug and has not been introduced into clinical practice.

uses.text: Ro48-8684 is a water-soluble benzodiazepine derivative developed by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1990s, which was designed along with Ro48-6791 as an improved replacement for midazolam, but ultimately proved to have little advantages over the parent drug and has not been introduced into clinical practice.

pharmacology.en: As a benzodiazepine, it boosts the effect of GABA at GABA-A receptors, the brain's main calming signal, which produces sedation.
pharmacology.zh: 作為苯二氮平類，它會增強 GABA 在 GABA-A 受體上的作用，也就是大腦主要的抑制訊號，因而產生鎮靜效果。
pharmacology.zhHans: 作为苯二氮平类，它会增强 GABA 在 GABA-A 受体上的作用，也就是大脑主要的抑制信号，因而产生镇静效果。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Benzodiazepines as a group cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and slowed reactions. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類整體而言會引起嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題和反應變慢。規律使用會導致依賴，長期大量使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷症狀，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类整体而言会引起嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题和反应变慢。规律使用会导致依赖，长期大量使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断症状，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Ro48-8684 was made water-soluble so that it could be injected without the solvents many benzodiazepines need. Midazolam solves the same problem in a different way, by changing shape in acid.
fact.zh: Ro48-8684 被設計成水溶性，這樣注射時就不需要許多苯二氮平所需的溶劑。咪達唑侖以另一種方式解決同樣的問題：在酸性環境中改變結構。
fact.zhHans: Ro48-8684 被设计成水溶性，这样注射时就不需要许多苯二氮平所需的溶剂。咪达唑仑以另一种方式解决同样的问题：在酸性环境中改变结构。
